text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, for the announcement! This year's 
Best Classic-tier Umamusume is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: I'm Furioso!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Thank you... very much. Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you grabbed hold of it with 
everything you had!

Yeah, you seized it with everything you 
had!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――The NAU Grand Prix. Furioso was honored 
by the National Association of Umamusume, 
or "NAU", the regional equivalent of the 
URA.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso won the Japan Dirt Derby, JBC 
Classic, Champions Cup, and Tokyo 
Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who win 4 or more GIs in their 
Classic Year are rare even in the JRA.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Furioso-san. Um, first of 
all—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Thank you so much for this award 
today.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful to so many people! To my 
Trainer, the staff, and all the fans, I 
offer my heartfelt thanks!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm sorry. I got ahead of myself...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"You're here for the interview, right? 
Pl-Please, go ahead..."

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
No, it gave me a clear sense of what a 
sincere Umamusume Furioso is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the ceremony proceeded—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, we will present bouquets to all 
of our award recipients.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the bouquet in hand, Furioso stood 
completely still for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
choice_data_list: Is something wrong with... that bouquet?
Is something wrong with... that bouquet?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... It's just that getting it out of 
nowhere caught me off guard... But...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It's beautiful... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I'd forgotten until recently. 
What a race truly was in the first place—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That it was something brilliant, praised 
by all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The end of this fiscal year was 
particularly grueling, after all. I had no 
room to enjoy any glamorous events.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I feel like we've been grinding away at 
each other's hearts and lives the whole 
time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we talked, in the corner of Furioso's 
eye, faint traces of...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, the tears just started coming 
out of nowhere... I guess I let my guard 
down...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"It is not as if I am weeping out of 
sorrow. Nor are these tears of joy, 
however..."
choice_data_list:
Good work today... That really took a lot 
out of you, huh.

Good work today... That really took a lot 
out of you, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, indeed. Looking back on it. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even realize how hard it was. Not 
until today... when I received this award.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Best Regional Classic Umamusume 
Award. Receiving it seemed to deeply, 
profoundly touch Furioso's heart.
